node.title: Hankel-kernel flats: coset-patterned supports => divisor-poset-sized lattice
node.statement: SATURATED formulation (Pro round 4, verified): for rate-1/2 Hankel-kernel instances over mu_n, after ROOT-CLOSURE saturation (count reachable forced-root closures rcl_P(B u S), NOT raw support unions) and after routing tangent/common-divisor and quotient/pullback/DIHEDRAL structure to the paid/reduced ledgers, the number of reachable UNPAID PRIMITIVE saturated closures is poly(n); AND terminal unpaid primitive leaves satisfy the direction-dual (moment/residue) cleanliness. Raw #L over-counts: the loop-free pair-family (weighted syndrome on non-coset A) is gcd-trivial AND primitive with raw #L = 2^|A|, yet ALL pairs share ONE root-closure = A (verified: 5 raw -> 1 closure). The 'many-atoms => paid' heavy lifting is f_many_sparse_structure (PROVED, four-branch crystallization).
node.attack_surface: v5 (post-critique): four lemmas — L1 descent stability PROVED (syndrome convolution, 1800/1800); L2 paid Luroth/rational-pullback quotient reduction (incl. the missing dihedral y=X+1/X reduction); L3 the HEREDITARY closure-entropy bound (THE core — local few-atoms does not imply poly reachable closures, per QF.12's own non-claims); L4 moment-clean leaves / pinned-value variant. f_many_sparse_structure supports the weight-2 branch (constant threshold via E35) but its w>=3 branch routes to Face-4 wall machinery — insufficient for hereditary use.

Loop-free pair-family refutes even v3 (primitive) at raw level, but collapses under rcl. The node is now an ASSEMBLY: f_many_sparse_structure (PROVED) + root-closure accounting + moment-clean leaves. Connects to the SPI/XR crystallization core (spi_exceptional_class). f_many_sparse_structure now LOAD-BEARING — flag for content audit. | ROUND 5: Pro's critique of v4 adjudicated LARGELY CORRECT (gap 3 the standout: my contrapositive overreached — QF.12 Remark 4.7's non-claim). The four-lemma v5 decomposition adopted. f_many_sparse_structure's w>=3 Face-4-wall routing = the sharpened content-audit flag. | ROUNDS 6-7 (the same Pro thread): L3 SOLVED-IN-ROUTE — the rank-profile dichotomy (row-deficient => principal GRS via binary apolarity, verified 4000/4000; wide => one rational class, separation verified 233k pairs/0 violations; narrow => dim O(W)) gives n^{O(W^2)} unpaid states via entropy/Kraft.
